explorer.examples.bounded-channel.descri: channel pacing for send and receive
queueBatches sends draft into the buffer, and writeBatches receives it without waiting.
queueBatches creates a capacity-one channel shared with writeBatches.
writeBatches later reaches an empty channel and waits for archive.
The review and publish sends reach a full channel and wait for writeBatches.

explorer.examples.future-settlement.guid: receiveSmsCode settles smsCode with the received code.
verifyPhoneNumber waits on smsCode until another process settles it.
scope-managed future and channel life cycles
openSession creates ticket and updates inside its child scope.
When openSession finishes, the owner scope cancels the unfinished future and revokes the open channel.
resumeCheckout can still use ticket and updates, but the runtime objects stay owned by the scope that created them.
Later wait and tryReceive only observe those terminal states.
explorer.examples.scope-owned-work.guide: publishArticle runs commitArticle inside enclose and later returns its result.
commitArticle produces published before updateSearchIndex finishes.
enclose creates a child scope that owns work spawned inside the boundary.
enclose waits for scope-owned work before returning.
